image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) standing on a grey, textured surface. The bird displays characteristic breeding male plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast, and black-and-white patterned wings. The background is a blurred, neutral grey.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out similar finch species or hybrid artifacts.
To analyze the fine-grained texture of the feathers for any signs of AI smearing, melting, or unnatural repetition.
To ensure clean separation between the complex wing feathers and the background, checking for edge bleeding or halo effects.
To verify the physical contact points of the feet with the ground and ensure no floating or structural collapse in the leg anatomy.
